adjudication.rationale: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the Zod `safeParse` result wrapper (`{ success, data, error }`) rather than the parsed token object itself (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, it `return refreshTokenResponse;`). In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the result is assigned directly to `key` and persisted via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, meaning the DB will store the wrapper object instead of the credential payload (previously it stored `googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)`). Other callers treat the return as a wrapper (e.g., Office365 spreads `tokenResponse.data`, Salesforce uses `accessTokenParsed.data`), so Google is inconsistent and will corrupt the credential shape for Google Calendar.
